# GimbalPushParams (push)

Gimbal GetPushParams - the gimbal's own periodic status push (pitch/roll/yaw + a status byte).

**Confidence:** V

**Provenance:** scripts/re/duml_telemetry.py's old `_gimbal_push` (struct.unpack_from("<hhh", ...) + status byte) - used operationally throughout this repo's verify.py/gimbal_sweep.py closed-loop tests (confirms real pitch/roll/yaw via telemetry, not just "sent"). status byte: bit0 = error flag, bits6-7 = mode (DataGimbalControl.MODE: 0=YawNoFollow, 1=FPV, 2=YawFollow - same enum as GimbalControl's mode_byte>>6, see this file's 0x04/0x01 entry). Had no Dart decoder before this entry - Python's was the only implementation.
